answer: At 10 units per epoch, sustaining 309 aliases for 25 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the hostile operator. The fee is charged through a sable debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the velvet totals, and the whisper anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 19 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
